policy: A seed only nominates a literature-supported exact-species mechanism and an optional human target locator. Strict status requires independent provider orthology (Ensembl, NCBI Ortholog, OMA or OrthoDB) plus Open Targets validation.

Somniosus microcephalus.rationale: Greenland shark longevity review summarizes genomic evidence of structural variation in tumor suppressor p53 in the context of genome maintenance and extreme longevity.

Eublepharis macularius.rationale: SOX2-positive radial glial neural stem/progenitor cells were identified in the leopard gecko neurogenic niche.
SOX9 expression was reported during leopard gecko tail regeneration and skeletal tissue differentiation.

Acomys cahirinus.rationale: Acomys cahirinus regenerative wound healing shows strongly elevated Il10; published cross-species comparison reports substantial peptide similarity to human IL-10.

Cynops pyrrhogaster.rationale: SHH is reactivated during Cynops pyrrhogaster limb regeneration; curated exact-species UniProt protein Q90385 exists.

Paracentrotus lividus.rationale: Paracentrotus lividus virgin eggs contain an AQP3-like protein with a functional role in high-velocity water flux; an independent exact-species cryodamage study identifies low membrane permeability and slow CPA/water movement as a major barrier to egg cryopreservation.
Paracentrotus lividus.promotion_rule: Do not count as strict until NCBI Ortholog, OrthoDB, OMA, Ensembl, or an equivalent exact-species phylogenetic dossier validates Paracentrotus lividus AQP3 -> human AQP3.
